### ✨ Mirrors of Albion Mod Menu (v9.10)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Activate Pro Currency & Energy Preset** — Enables Freeze Energy, Spend = Gain Currency, 10x Gold & 10x EXP
- **Freeze Energy (Infinite Energy)** — Energy never decreases when exploring rooms or banishing anomalies
- **Free Purchases** — Buy items, chests, tools & upgrades without losing Gold or Crystals
- **Spend = Gain Currency** — Spending Gold or Crystals increases your balance instead of decreasing
- **Gold & Crystal Multiplier** — Multiplies all Gold & Crystals earned from scenes and quests
- **EXP Multiplier** — Multiplies all EXP earned from hidden-object scenes and quests

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
